name: Samuel Brandão
bio: Samuel Brandão Lopes (January 25, 2002) is a Brazilian film director and a Film and Audiovisual student at the Federal University of Mato Grosso do Sul. Samuel won the contest “1 Minute of Cinema Inspired by Literature” with Fausto (2026).
